4. Thus, our strategy includes collecting lilies of the valley first, then using them to get enough bone meal to create the white dye.
5. Collect 3 lily of the valley.
6. Craft 1 white dye using 1 lily of the valley.
7. Now we have 1 white dye.
8. Next, we need 9 more bone meal to craft 1 bone block (since 1 bone block requires 9 bone meal), which will eventually lead us to our goal.
9. We already have 1 dye, so we still have 8 bone meal left to craft.
10. Craft 3 bone meal using 1 bone.
11. To get 1 bone, we need to collect another 3 lilies of the valley.
12. Collect 3 lily of the valley.
13. Craft 1 white dye using 1 lily of the valley (we now have 2 white dyes in total).
14. We now have 1 remaining dye and 2 bone in stock.
15. Craft 2 sets of 3 bone meal using 2 bones.
16. This creates 6 bone meal.
17. Add this to the 1 bone meal we're already accumulating towards making the bone blocks.
18. We now have 7 bone meal.
19. Finally, craft 1 final set of bone meal using 1 bone.
20. We now have exactly 8 bone meal.
21. Using the 8 bone meal, we can craft 1 bone block.
22. Using the 1 bone block we just crafted, we can craft the remaining 1 bone meal.
23. Now we have 9 bone meal.
24. And with 9 bone meal, we can craft the final white dye.
25. Our goal is reached!

Thus, the exact ordered sequence of steps is:

1. Collect 3 lily of the valley.
2. Craft 1 white dye using 1 lily of the valley.
3. Collect 3 more lily of the valleys.
4. Craft 2 white dyes.
5. Collect 3 more lily of valleys.
6. Craft 2 sets of bone meal using 3 bones each.
7. Collect 1 more lily of valley.
8. Craft 1 set of bone meal using 1 bone.
9. Craft 1 white dye using 1 lily of the valley.
10. Use the 8 bone meal to craft 1 blue diamond sword.
11. Craft 1 bone block using 9 bone meal.
12. With 1 bone block crafted, use the remaining 1 bone meal to craft 1 more white dye.
13. The goal is successfully achieved!
